overview.text: Soil_1_15 is a terpene biosynthetic gene cluster detected by antiSMASH, DeepBGC and GECCO.
It spans 21 kb on contig_1 and contains 22 genes.

genes.text: antiSMASH marks four genes as biosynthetic, comprising one core gene and three additional genes.
The core gene CJLEIP_01467 encodes a terpene synthase and is identified as a core terpene gene by antiSMASH and GECCO.
Three additional biosynthetic genes are present: CJLEIP_01462 encodes a short chain dehydrogenase, CJLEIP_01469 encodes citramalate synthase, and CJLEIP_01472 encodes urease subunit alpha.

similar.text: The closest MIBiG entry is BGC0001181 (geosmin) from Streptomyces coelicolor A3(2), a terpene cluster with questionable annotation quality.

One gene of the locus has a counterpart in that cluster at sixty-four percent identity, and antiSMASH finds counterparts for one hundred percent of the reference cluster's genes, representing a moderate match.

hypothesis.text: The cluster may produce a volatile terpene such as geosmin, given the terpene synthase core gene matching a geosmin cyclase and the presence of a citramalate synthase that could supply isoprenoid precursors; the additional dehydrogenase and urease genes together with the surrounding transporters and regulators could support primary metabolic functions rather than a specialised metabolite.

facts.sentence: Soil_1_15 is a terpene cluster, found by antiSMASH, DeepBGC and GECCO (all three detection tools).
It spans 21 kb on contig_1 (1,729,580–1,750,790) and contains 22 genes.
antiSMASH marks 4 genes as biosynthetic (1 core and 3 additional), 2 as regulatory and 1 as transport.
1 core gene is named in the locus.
CJLEIP_01467, annotated by Bakta as Terpene synthase, is named as a core gene by antiSMASH and GECCO; antiSMASH classes it as a core terpene gene.
CJLEIP_01462 encodes Short chain dehydrogenase and is marked by antiSMASH as an additional biosynthetic gene.
CJLEIP_01469 encodes citramalate synthase and is marked by antiSMASH as an additional biosynthetic gene.
CJLEIP_01472 encodes Urease subunit alpha and is marked by antiSMASH as an additional biosynthetic gene.

Gene products in the locus, in genome order: CJLEIP_01452 SRPBCC family protein; CJLEIP_01453 Knr4/Smi1-like domain-containing protein; CJLEIP_01454 hypothetical protein; CJLEIP_01455 Murein biosynthesis integral membrane protein MurJ; CJLEIP_01456 Calcium-binding protein; CJLEIP_01457 Knr4/Smi1-like domain-containing protein; CJLEIP_01458 MerR family transcriptional regulator; CJLEIP_01459 VOC domain-containing protein; CJLEIP_01460 DUF309 domain-containing protein; CJLEIP_01461 TetR family transcriptional regulator; CJLEIP_01462 Short chain dehydrogenase; CJLEIP_01463 ATP-binding protein; CJLEIP_01464 XRE family transcriptional regulator; CJLEIP_01465 DUF397 domain-containing protein; CJLEIP_01466 DUF397 domain-containing protein; CJLEIP_01467 Terpene synthase; CJLEIP_01468 TPM domain-containing protein; CJLEIP_01469 citramalate synthase; CJLEIP_01470 MFS dicarboxylate transporter; CJLEIP_01471 Agmatine deiminase; CJLEIP_01472 Urease subunit alpha; CJLEIP_01473 urease.
The closest MIBiG entry is BGC0001181 (geosmin), from Streptomyces coelicolor A3(2).
1 gene of the locus has a counterpart in BGC0001181, at 64 % identity; antiSMASH finds counterparts for 100 % of that cluster's genes. Overall this is a moderate match.
CJLEIP_01467 matches CAB41566.1 (putative cyclase) of BGC0001181 at 64 % identity.
MIBiG lists the compound class of BGC0001181 as terpene.
MIBiG rates the annotation quality of BGC0001181 as questionable.
